whenToUse: Offers with a fixed end time, such as a flash sale.
Booking or application deadlines are close.
Time is really limited, as with a payment hold.
whenNotToUse: Fake deadlines that restart on refresh (see fake urgency).
There are days left until the deadline (show the date only).
Screens with no reason to pressure people.

alternatives.name: Fake Urgency
alternatives.reason: Seeing why a restarting timer is a problem.

alternatives.name: Low Stock Indicator
alternatives.reason: When quantity, not time, is limited.

accessibility: The numbers changing every second are aria-hidden, and the end time is read as text.
When it ends, announce it once with role="status".
Show the time left in words and numbers, not relying on color.
